name: STLLoss
run: vehicle compile loss -s spec.vcl -l STLLoss -o STLLoss.vcl

name: DL2Loss
run: vehicle compile loss -s spec.vcl -l DL2Loss -o DL2Loss.vcl

name: Marabou
run: vehicle compile queries -s spec.vcl -f MarabouQueries -o Marabou.queries/ --network f:fake.onnx

name: Marabou3d
run: vehicle compile queries -s spec3d.vcl -f MarabouQueries -o Marabou3d.queries/ --network g:fake.onnx

name: Agda
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Agda -o Agda.agda

name: Rocq
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq.v

name: Isabelle
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Isabelle -o isabelle/Isabelle.thy

name: Imandra
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Imandra -o Imandra.iml

name: Rocq2d
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec2d.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq2d.v

name: RocqVerify2d
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec2d.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq2d.v && rocq compile -w none -vok Rocq2d.v

name: Isabelle2d
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec2d.vcl -t Isabelle -o isabelle/Isabelle2d.thy

name: IsabelleVerify2d
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec2d.vcl -t Isabelle -o isabelle/Isabelle2d.thy && isabelle build -d vehicle-isabelle/ -d isabelle/ IsabelleTest2d > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo $? || echo 1
